Here’s what changed after the audit.

### Removed (treat as non–solution hotfixes / policy experiments)
- **React `createDataTable`**: `autoResize: false`, disabling cell `tooltip`s with the Tabulator “Event Target …” rationale, stripping `headerClass`, and `void settings`.
- **` dataset.rowKind`**: debug-style DOM state with no bearing on `separator_before`.
- **Legacy `tables.html`**: opt-in knobs `stripedRows`, `stripedColumnGroups`, `showVerticalGroupSeparators`, conditional `custom-tabulator is-striped-rows`, reading group stripes from renderer options instead of payload `config.stripedColGroups`, and gated vertical group borders / bootstrap striping keyed off those options instead of **`config`**.
- **`DataTableOptions.stripedColumnGroups`**: dropped from `types.ts`; React uses **`tableConfig.stripedColGroups`** again like before.

### Kept (contract / parity)
- **Backend**: `separator_before`, documented `row_metadata` keys (`table_data.py`), and moving the heavy `borderTop` rule out of inline `styling` in favor of a shared separator treatment (`league_service.py`).
- **Legacy**: `shouldRenderSemanticSeparator`, `getEffectiveRowStyling`, `tab-row-separator-before` on Tabulator + bootstrap paths, CSS for separators, **`useStripedGroups` from `tableConfig.stripedColGroups`**.
- **React**: `hasSemanticSeparator`, row formatter stripping `borderTop` when a semantic separator applies, **`headerClass`** restored, **`settings.tooltips`** driving Tabulator tooltips again.
- **Dev wiring** (counts as aligning contracts): Flask default `:5000` in `vite.config.ts` (+ `BOWLYZER_DEV_API`), matching `start.sh`, and the `api.ts` comment. Left as-is.
- **`RowMetaEntry`**: tightened docs and added **`rowType`** next to **`separator_before`** so the TS model matches Flask.

### Note on `String(...)` around `displayValue`
That stays: without it you get **`string | number`** from `formatted`/cell values vs `positionCircle`/`string` expectations. **`npx tsc --noEmit`** in `frontend/` is clean (`vp` isn’t on your PATH in this shell).

Untracked **lockfiles / `.specstory`** were not modified. If you want the branch to be strictly “contract hardening”, consider not committing speculative root `package-lock.json` unless you deliberately added deps.

Yes — that discussion was about **semantic intent in the payload** vs **visual policy in the UI**, with **semantic separators** driven by **`row_metadata`** (especially `separator_before` / `rowType`). After the cleanup, we’re aligned with **not** shifting striping/grid ownership into speculative React-only knobs until those are spelled out again.

I captured the **decisions + implementation status** in:

[docs/TABLE_VISUALIZATION_OWNERSHIP.md](https://github.com/cfell/bowlyzer_legacy/blob/main/docs/TABLE_VISUALIZATION_OWNERSHIP.md) — path on disk: `docs/TABLE_VISUALIZATION_OWNERSHIP.md`.

### Condensed recap

| Decision | Implemented? |
|----------|----------------|
| **Grid lines (`horizontalLines` / `verticalLines`): frontend-only, default off** | **Partial** — React `.ds-tabulator` still adds a border between every pair of rows (`datatable.css`). |
| **Semantic separators: backend marks (`separator_before` / `rowType`), frontend renders** | **Partial** — Flask + legacy `tables.html` wired; React toggles the class but **has no `.tab-row-separator-before` CSS yet**, so separators are easy to miss. |
| **`striped` (zebra): frontend-owned, backend not authoritative** | **Not done** — legacy Bootstrap still respects `config.striped`; Tabulator legacy still zebras even rows. |
| **`stripedColGroups`: keep as backend hint for now** | **Yes** — still read from `tableConfig.stripedColGroups`. |
| **`hover`: frontend** | **Yes (React)** — hover styling in DS theme; not gated by backend. |
| **`compact`: frontend default on, backend field fades out** | **Not done** — React still treats `config.compact` as authority. |
| **`stickyHeader`: frontend when body scrolls** | **Unclear / minimal** — no explicit sticky-header work in React datatable. |
| **`width`: shared (hint + FE layout)** | **Yes** — existing behaviour. |
| **Heatmaps: domain-sensitive; keep broadly as-is** | **Not refactored** — no new cross-cutting contract. |
| **`highlighted` groups: backend intent, FE styling** | **Yes** |
| **`frozen`: backend semantic for sticky cols** | **Yes** |

The doc ties each row to **files**, calls out gaps, and lists **checkboxes for the next sprint** when you resume. If you want this duplicated into `frontend/AGENTS.md` as a one-liner link, say so and we can add only that pointer (small diff).
